dialogue.speaker: Zulfiya
dialogue.text: Daniyar, I'm checking the weather forecast for this weekend. It looks quite interesting!

dialogue.speaker: Daniyar
dialogue.text: What does it say? We wanted to go to the city park on Saturday, remember?

dialogue.speaker: Zulfiya
dialogue.text: Saturday is going to be partly cloudy with a temperature of minus two degrees. And quite windy.

dialogue.speaker: Daniyar
dialogue.text: Minus two and windy? That's colder than today. Today it's zero degrees and calm.

dialogue.speaker: Zulfiya
dialogue.text: Yes — Saturday is colder and windier than today. The wind speed is thirty kilometres per hour.

dialogue.speaker: Daniyar
dialogue.text: That sounds unpleasant. And Sunday — is it any better?

dialogue.speaker: Zulfiya
dialogue.text: Sunday is much better! Sunny and calm — almost no wind at all. The temperature rises to plus four.

dialogue.speaker: Daniyar
dialogue.text: Plus four and sunny sounds perfect! Can we go on Sunday instead of Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: Zulfiya
dialogue.text: We could. But the forecast also says there may be light snow on Saturday afternoon. That could actually be beautiful!

dialogue.speaker: Daniyar
dialogue.text: Light snow in the afternoon — you're right, that sounds lovely for a walk. Is Saturday morning cold?

dialogue.speaker: Zulfiya
dialogue.text: Saturday morning is the coldest part — minus five before noon. But it gets warmer through the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: Daniyar
dialogue.text: What should I wear if we go Saturday? I have my thick coat and waterproof boots.

dialogue.speaker: Zulfiya
dialogue.text: Wear your warmest coat, a hat, gloves, and definitely the waterproof boots — the paths might be slippery.

dialogue.speaker: Daniyar
dialogue.text: Perfect. Let's go Saturday morning when it's still clear — before the snow starts!

task1Items.question: Saturday's temperature is forecast to be minus two degrees.
The wind speed on Saturday is forty kilometres per hour.
Sunday is forecast to be colder and windier than Saturday.
There may be light snow on Saturday afternoon.
Saturday morning is the warmest part of the day.
Daniyar and Zulfiya decide to go to the park on Saturday morning.
